### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cc14657ede79cd315fa7647da238a48a6ede9b88` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8ccbeda9d43563e3a31115d328f78d58622325f1`
Local-runs: none

PR #23314 (`Part of #22871`, draft, 4 files, +19/−12, not governed: none of `.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`). Base `280806912`, which is an ancestor of `origin/main` `14a13bce0`; `main` has not touched `packages/spec/liveness/**` or the lint test since that base (only new `.changeset/*.md` files landed). Read: card #22871 body and all 16 comments (seat answer `6151023438`, claim `6147217218`, amendment `6151040021`, ACCEPT `6154419315` as a claim under test), ruling `6116489638` on #22870, the PR body, its one bot comment, the file list, the net diff, PR #23303 as context, the check-runs on this head, and the heads by sha through read-only git.

### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) The reader is real on `main` alone, and `live` is the ledger's own word for it.** `packages/services/service-mailbox/src/ingest/match-records.ts` at `main` declares `export class MailRecordMatcher`; its `match(organizationId, addresses)` calls `flaggedFieldsOf(engine)`, which keeps exactly the fields where `def.type === 'email' && def.mailAssociation === true` (skipping the three mail objects and any flagged object with no `organization_id` column, said once) and reads them under the system context scoped to the mailbox's organization; `mail-ingest-service.ts` calls `this.matcher.match` at ingest (line 318, `linksFor` → one `sys_mail_association` row per match) and at re-match (line 426). No other path reads the flag. The reader is reachable on `main` today: `MailboxServicePlugin.init()` registers `MailIngestService` as the kernel service `mailbox`; `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` boots that plugin for every host declaring `requires: ['mailbox']` (the showcase does); `MailIngestService` is exported from the package index; `rematch` is a door for the system context, a `manage_mailboxes` holder or the mailbox owner, and `ingest` for the system context — a host plugin on `main` can hand the seam a message now, and the stage-1 kernel suite (`mailbox-service-kernel.test.ts`, `Field.email({ mailAssociation: true })` on a booted kernel over real ObjectQL) proves the end-to-end on `main`. Under the ledger's vocabulary (`liveness/README.md`): `live` = "has a runtime consumer; authoring the property changes runtime behaviour", `planned` = "declared, intentionally not enforced yet". The flag is enforced wherever a message reaches the seam; what `main` lacks is an in-repo mail *source*, not a reader. The `producer` criterion does not bite: the consumer reads the authored value directly off the registered schema (the README's "author IS the producer" row), and the addresses it compares against are derived inside `ingest` from the message itself. The row's own flip condition, written by #22870's seeding, is met verbatim: "Flip to `live` when the ingest lands, citing its matcher symbol, and drop `authorWarn` / `authorHint` in that same edit." Keeping `planned` + `authorWarn` would ship the hint "no mailbox service reads this yet" as a false author warning (the #19187 lesson recorded in this same file at the `relatedListFilter` row), and `check:liveness` refuses `authorWarn` on a `live` row, so the flip must drop both — it does. The stage-1 dev's reservation (report `6145035987`: "the author-visible effect is still absent") conflates a missing source with a missing reader; the ledger grades readers.
- **(b) The row.** `status: live`; `verifiedAt: 2026-10-13` (well-formed, not future-dated); `evidence` carries three repo-local citations and every one resolves on the head: `match-records.ts#MailRecordMatcher` (one identifier, the form `check:liveness` accepts — a dotted `#MailRecordMatcher.match` fails its `[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*` rule, so citing the class and naming `match` → `flaggedFieldsOf` in the prose is the right spelling; the file names the key 4 times), `field.zod.ts#mailAssociation` (line 1504 declares it, the superRefine at line 2253 refuses it off `type: 'email'`), and `field-mail-association.test.ts` (exists, 27 key mentions). The key-mention check is satisfied for each cited file. The `Spec property liveness` check-run (which runs `check:liveness`: anchors, key mention, `verifiedAt`, the warned-row census and the state-counts freshness leg) is green on this head. The evidence prose is accurate: the flagged email fields are the only fields matched against, inside the organization, one `sys_mail_association` row per match at ingest and at re-match. The trimmed `note` (commit `8ccbeda9d`, the only change since `4d4fac733`, one line): every sentence holds on `main` with this PR alone — the ruling citation (Q1 → A, field-level key valid only on `type: 'email'`, no resolver contract) matches `6116489638`; "the first of the two stages of #22871, the ingest seam and the matcher, which landed at 82581819b" is true (`82581819b` is an ancestor of the base); the second stage is named as the card's stage that feeds the seam "and does not change what reads this key" without claiming it landed; the hint's history is stated correctly; "takes effect only where the mailbox capability is composed" is a true necessary condition. The replaced clause ("It landed in two stages … then the IMAP connector … and the mailbox sync") would have been false on `main` and is gone.
- **(c) Derived changes are exact.** `authorWarnedProperties('field')` → `['conditionalRequired']`: that row is `dead` (warns by verdict, no marker), and after this edit no `field.json` row carries `authorWarn` at any depth — the function is ledger-driven (`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts`, un-memoised), so the pin follows the row, and the test's comment now records the flip under #22871. `state-counts/field.md`: `94 → 95` live, `4 → 3` planned, `99` classified unchanged; at the gate's leaf granularity `main`'s four planned are `settledWhen`, `conditionalFormatting.condition`, `conditionalFormatting.style`, `mailAssociation`, and the head's three drop the last — consistent, and the gate's byte-compare freshness leg is green on the head. No other count site exists: the README state table carries no count columns since #7377 (no `94` or `4 planned` anywhere else on `main`), `llms.txt` carries no liveness counts, the docs (`content/docs/references/data/field.mdx`, `object.mdx`, `system/migration.mdx`) and the Studio `helpText` describe the key conditionally ("when a mailbox service ingests a message") with no status claim, and no test other than the pin asserts the planned warning for `mailAssociation`. The docs-drift bot's "2 files yielded no anchor" is the ledger and shard, which are not documentable surfaces; nothing restating the row's status exists to move.
- **(d) Changeset `.changeset/22871-mail-association-live.md`.** Owed: `liveness/` ships in `@objectstack/spec`'s `files`, and `os lint` / `os validate` read it through `authoring-rules.ts` → `lintLivenessProperties`, so a consumer-visible warning disappears — never `skip-changeset`. `patch` is the right level: a false author warning is a defect, nothing is added; `Clause-②: no` is right: the PR touches no `.zod.ts`, `FieldSchema`'s refine accepts and refuses exactly as before, no export, key or default moves, and a warning narrowing widens no accept set. The ADR-0087 gate's own accepted shape is a bare `Clause-②: no` on `'@objectstack/spec': patch`; precedent on `main`'s CHANGELOG: `17.7.0` patch "the `flows` row drops `authorWarn` and its `authorHint` … no longer warn `liveness-planned-property`", and `18.0.0-next` patch flipping the `requiredPermissions` rows `live`. Pre mode (`.changeset/pre.json` = `pre` / `next`): a patch moves the fixed group (71 packages, spec and service-mailbox among them) one `-next.N` — right; no second package line is owed, `service-mailbox` is unchanged. Every sentence true on `main` alone: the matcher reads the key; the warning no longer fires; the row moves as stated, citing `MailRecordMatcher`; the counts move as stated. No tracker number in the author-facing body. `Check Changeset` is green.
- **(e) Interaction with PR #23303** (head `5e075ec2f`, still carrying `610e112bd`): compared patch for patch, `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts` and `state-counts/field.md` are byte-identical in both PRs, and `field.json` differs on exactly one line, the `note` (`status`, `verifiedAt`, `evidence` identical). Whichever lands second meets a conflict on that one line only (the identical lines merge clean); resolving to `main`'s side is correct in either order — the trimmed note claims only what `main` holds and stays true after #23303 lands, while the untrimmed note's landing claim is only true once #23303 is in. #23303's changeset no longer lists `@objectstack/spec`, so the flip is released once. The cherry-pick is exact: `69ae02b6d`'s change lines equal `610e112bd`'s, diff for diff.
- **(f) CI on `8ccbeda9d`:** 41 check-runs, 35 success, 0 failure, 0 pending. Non-green = 6 skips, every one on `EXPECTED_SKIPS` (`scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs`): `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, the `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrix-shard job, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`. `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, all six `Test Core` shards and every Lint and Type Check job are green. No legacy commit statuses.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no` — correct. Pre mode `next`; one fixed-group pre-release bump. No `minor` is owed (nothing widens) and no breaking arm exists (nothing narrows the accept set or removes anything authorable).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Non-blocking, wording: the note's "the card's second stage … feeds that same seam" is present tense about a stage that has not landed; it reads as the stage's design, and the commit message says no landing is claimed, but "is to feed" would close the reading. The `note` is maintainer prose never shown to an author.
- Non-blocking, measured: on `main` no code outside `service-mailbox` calls the `mailbox` service (0 hits), so until #23303 lands the only producer of messages to the seam is a host's own call. The row's "takes effect only where the mailbox capability is composed" is a necessary condition, not a sufficient one; `live` is still the right grade because the ledger grades readers, and the reader is wired and reachable.
- Non-blocking: the row carries no `evidenceScope`; absent is a worklist state, not a failure. `in-repo` would be accurate.
- Non-blocking: the API still reports `mergeable: unknown` for this draft at read time (lazily computed; a `merge_commit_sha` exists). `main` has not touched any of the four paths since the base, so a clean merge is expected; the seat confirms `mergeable: clean` at the pre-queue check as usual.
- Not this PR's: `main`'s `.changeset/22871-mail-ingest-seam.md` still says "no mail source feeds the seam", which remains true until #23303 lands and is superseded by that PR's changeset.
